artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan landing the open-future non-definability result as FormalSystem/Metalogic/Independence/OpenFutureUndefinable.lean, with eleven measured C14 axiom pins, two conditional theorem-index rows, and the directory README's fourteenth numbered result.

memory_candidates.content: In the BimodalLogic repository, landing ONE new .lean module under FormalSystem/ obliges five machine-owned surfaces beyond the module and its directory aggregator, each with its own gate: (1) FormalSystem.lean, the generated library root, asserted byte-for-byte against `mk_all --lib FormalSystem` by check-module-invariants.sh C33 -- regenerate with C33's render algorithm, never hand-insert; (2) the C14 axiom baseline, a MATCHED PAIR of heredocs (C14BASE values and C14LEAN `#print axioms` lines) inside check-module-invariants.sh, compared by exact string equality so order and relative position matter as much as the values; (3) the generated `<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory -->` blocks in the directory README and its parent, rewritten only by `check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory`; (4) typst/generated/status.typ's repository file/line counts, gated by typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 and repaired by `typst-sync-check.sh --fix` (needs a built library); (5) docs/theorem-index.md rows, whose Axioms column is GENERATED FROM the C14 baseline rather than typed, so the pin must precede the row. A plan that lists only the module, the aggregator and the README understates the scope by three paths.
